environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed in VPC subnet-0e4f5g6h (us-west-2c). The Step Functions workflow is configured identically. However, the product-service GraphQL endpoint (ECS Fargate) is deployed in an isolated subnet group and is ONLY accessible through a VPC Endpoint Service (AWS PrivateLink) with endpoint policy restricting the consumer to the specific Lambda security group sg-0abc123. The VPC endpoint (vpce-0x9y8z7w) has a custom endpoint policy that enforces a condition: the connection must originate from the Step Functions VPC endpoint (source-vpce: vpce-0sfn456). Additionally, the Network Load Balancer fronting the product service has a TLS listener (port 443 only) with mutual TLS authentication requiring a client certificate issued by ACM PCA (arn:aws:acm-pca:us-west-2:111122223333:certificate-authority/abc-def-123). The Lambda's environment does NOT contain the mTLS client certificate or private key material — these are injected only when the invocation source ARN matches the specific state machine ARN (arn:aws:states:us-west-2:111122223333:stateMachine:ProductSearchWorkflow) via a Lambda Extension that validates the invoking principal before mounting the certificate from Secrets Manager. Without valid mTLS credentials, the NLB terminates the connection at the TLS handshake before any GraphQL query reaches the product service.

config.nlb_listener: TLS:443, mutual TLS required, ACM PCA CA: arn:aws:acm-pca:us-west-2:111122223333:certificate-authority/abc-def-123
config.lambda_extension: cert-injector-v2.3, validates invocation source ARN before mounting mTLS material from SecretsManager
config.network_isolation: product-service in isolated subnet, no IGW, no NAT, only NLB ENI ingress
config.security_group_nlb: sg-0nlb999: inbound TCP/443 from sg-0abc123 only
